name: Ossren Mate-Cardamom Still
description: A lightly caffeinated still beverage using synth-mate and synth-cardamom, marketed as a focus aid for augmented workers. Sold in slim matte cans with minimal design — intentionally understated.
flavor_profile: Bitter, grassy mate base softened by warm cardamom spice, slightly sweet, no carbonation
cultural_context: Ossren targets the augmented worker demographic directly — its marketing appears almost exclusively in BCI peripheral ad space during work-shift hours. It's the drink people drink without thinking about it, which is exactly the brand strategy.
story_hooks: Ossren's BCI ad delivery system has been hacked to insert subliminal purchase prompts into the peripheral feed — someone is using the brand's ad infrastructure as a delivery mechanism for something else entirely.
A labor organizer is building a case that Ossren's 'focus aid' compounds suppress certain types of divergent cognition — essentially a legal productivity drug marketed as a soft drink.

An Ossren distribution driver has been quietly skimming cans from shipments to sell on the Shelf at markup — small scale, until she noticed someone else was doing the same thing on her route and the math stopped adding up.
